about.line1: <bold>Scientific Crafts</bold> is an independent scientific project created to make science engaging and accessible to a broad audience through hands-on experiments. It features videos of experiments, detailed guides, and downloadable templates covering physics, chemistry, STEM, and related topics.
about.line2: The project began in 2018 as a video series of scientific experiments and is now expanding into an interactive web platform, bringing experiments, explanations, and templates together in one accessible place.
